results.artistName: Mikoto Yamaguchi, D.P, Arbash Mughal & Giuseppe Di Martino
results.description: The Dragons of Hilmzeld tear family and society asunder…Can the Hatsushimas weather their tyranny with their bonds intact?The so-called “Dragon” of Hilmzeld turned out to be a pair of twins— one who would lead the society that worships them to war, and another who would lead them to peace. With Sasae MIA after a duel against a Dragon, it is up to the Hatsushima women to muddle through without him. But when Kanae takes pity on an injured Dragon twin, she lays the groundwork for a war within the family…And all the while, Hilmzeld is gripped ever tighter by chaos and terror!
